Bill.BriefDescription: Placing restrictions on the sale price of motor fuel.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to motor fuel retailers; and adding a new sectionto chapter 19.120 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 19.120 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A motor fuel retailer shall not sell motor fuel at a price thatincludes a fraction of one cent.
